# spaceman password

Your password: change it (passwords come from files or standard input).

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| [`spaceman password change`](#spaceman-password-change) | Change your password |

## spaceman password change

Change your password.

```sh
spaceman password change [flags]
```

API: `change-password` ([HTTP API](../api)).

Example:

```sh
spaceman password change --current-password-file ./old --new-password-stdin < ./new
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--current-password-file` | string |  | your current password (read from this file; never pass secrets as flag values) |
| `--current-password-stdin` | bool |  | read --current-password-file's value from standard input instead |
| `-f`, `--file` | string |  | request body as a JSON or YAML file (- reads standard input); flags override its fields |
| `--new-password-file` | string |  | the new password (read from this file; never pass secrets as flag values) |
| `--new-password-stdin` | bool |  | read --new-password-file's value from standard input instead |
